name: Kish
overview: The name Kish appears in Scripture referring to several individuals, notably the father of Saul, Israel's first king, who was a Benjamite (Acts 13:21). Kish also appears as a Levite, identified as a son of Mahli, whose descendants cared for the daughters of Eleazar (1 Chronicles 23:21-22). Additionally, Kish is recognized as the great-grandfather of Mordecai, a prominent Benjamite in the book of Esther (Esther 2:5). These references highlight Kish's significance in both tribal lineage and God's providential unfolding of His purposes through chosen individuals.
